name: ai-workstation
description: IMA AI 工作台 - 智能助手平台
author: IMA Team

scripts.install:all: pnpm install && cd client && pnpm install && cd ../server && pnpm install
scripts.build:all: cd client && pnpm build && cd ../server && pnpm build
scripts.electron:dev: concurrently -k -n "SERVER,CLIENT,ELECTRON" -c "blue,green,magenta" "pnpm --filter server dev" "pnpm --filter client dev" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && electron ."
scripts.electron:build: pnpm build:all && pnpm electron:compile && electron-builder -c electron-builder.json
scripts.electron:build:win: pnpm build:all && pnpm electron:compile && electron-builder -c electron-builder.json --win
scripts.electron:build:mac: pnpm build:all && pnpm electron:compile && electron-builder -c electron-builder.json --mac
scripts.electron:build:linux: pnpm build:all && pnpm electron:compile && electron-builder -c electron-builder.json --linux
